# Load the datasets

# First, find the maximum value in the AxesCelts_inter column

# Determine the century
century = max_axes_celts_inter_ce // 100

# Print the century
century

import pandas as pd

# Load the capital dataset
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')

# Replace commas with periods in the 'ZBeil' column
capital_df['ZBeil'] = capital_df['ZBeil'].str.replace(',', '.')

# Convert the 'ZBeil' column to numeric values
capital_df['ZBeil'] = pd.to_numeric(capital_df['ZBeil'], errors='coerce')

# Focus on the ZBeil column (Axes & Celts)
z_beil_data = capital_df[['BCE', 'ZBeil']]

# Determine the maximum value in the ZBeil column
max_z_beil = z_beil_data['ZBeil'].max()

# Find all BCE values where ZBeil is close to the maximum value
close_max_values = z_beil_data[z_beil_data['ZBeil'] >= max_z_beil - 0.1]

# Print the BCE values and their corresponding ZBeil values
close_max_values[['BCE', 'ZBeil']]
